after.hook: A WebHarbor preprint tests whether training on reconstructed websites helps visual-interface agents handle new web tasks.
after.fact: The authors report 153 reconstructed website environments and 3,518 tasks. A Qwen 4B-level agent trained there performed competitively with leading open-source web agents across four benchmarks; the environments and results are reported by the preprint authors.
after.evidence: Preprint abstract and author-reported benchmark results; not independent validation.
